skills.description: Close the toaster oven door from a measured nearly upright state: release, clear, approach and seat.

versions.when_to_use: Nearly upright door; downward wrist; visible right-camera rim, roof and fixed lip. Arc-reference tracking; all image boxes and observation_step are fresh parameters. Full seating observed on seed 9; this does not cover grasping a lowered door.

Nearly upright door; current fingerpad geometry; right-camera roof and rim. Cartesian tracking supports a tilted wrist. Seed 25 completed during release/clearance; later seating branches were not exercised by that success. Subsequent failures remain recorded.

Same nearly upright procedure with independently selectable oven_camera. Use a fresh unobscured roof region when the right roof view is blocked. Seed 44 completed during clearance; no evidence of all subsequent branches working.

skills.description: Close the toaster oven door after open fingers have already cleared the raised door.

versions.when_to_use: Open fingers with measured upper clearance already achieved; retain height, withdraw, close and seat. Fresh right-camera rim, roof and fixed-lip parameters. Do not restart a blocked upward clearance stage.

skills.description: Close the toaster oven door from measured closed-finger exterior clearance and stalled alignment.

versions.when_to_use: High exterior clearance and closed fingers achieved. Bounded integral position feedback and latched angular targets during alignment. camera, arc_reference and resume flags are parameters; resume flags require current measured prerequisites.

Closed fingers at high exterior clearance; stalled wrist alignment. Measured outward relocation before alignment; current camera, fixed lip and alignment_withdrawal_m inputs. Checks require actual clearance and movement.

Closed exterior pose; height restoration blocked before alignment. Bounded outward relocation precedes height restoration. Cartesian tracking, current camera, clearance_above_roof_m and alignment_withdrawal_m; do not assume contact from resume flags.

skills.description: Finish closing the toaster oven door from an already achieved exterior approach/contact pose.

versions.when_to_use: Current downward exterior alignment and approach already achieved; fresh paired upper-rim measurements and current lateral pose. Final seating with independent tracking. No initial grasp or clearance procedure is established by this variant.

Achieved exterior contact approach after withdrawal/lowering. Paired thin upper-lip tracking; current camera, resume and tracking flags, bounded clearance radius. Select flags only when current checks establish the corresponding entry state.
